expected_trees.algorithm: Canonical SHA1 Git tree object: directory-aware byte-name order; raw octal mode, space, basename, NUL, 20 raw object-ID bytes; hash with tree-length header. Four nonrecursive git ls-tree reads only; no mktree, hash-object -w, index operation, or repository-tree recursion.
expected_trees.publication_gate: The returned GitHub CreateTree SHA must equal repository_root_tree before creating a commit; its parent tree must be the fixed carrier tree. The values change whenever included bytes or modes change.
